answer: One concrete defense is bonded staking: each agent locks real collateral to mint an identity, so spinning up a gale of fake personas costs real capital rather than being a free haven for spammers. A sybil swarm that would otherwise flock in like a raven murder now faces linear cost per identity, while honest agents recover their bond through sustained good behavior. Slashing misbehavers makes mass fake-identity attacks economically irrational.
